name: impact_shock
label: Impact and shock conditions
description: Extracts projectile, target and shock-state values for each impact or shock experiment.
system_prompt: Extract values from a scientific paper. Report only what the paper states.
intro: Extracts projectile, target and shock-state values for each impact or shock experiment. For every set (and sample) in the structure plan below, extract the values the paper reports. A value that holds for every set goes in ONE row with `set` ''; one that differs between sets goes in each set's row; one that differs between the samples of a set goes in each sample's row.

parameters.description: Speed of the projectile, particle or impactor at impact.
Peak pressure reached in the shocked material.
Peak temperature reached in the material during shock compression or heating.
Angle of incidence of the impactor relative to the surface normal.
Material or type of the projectile or impactor (e.g. polystyrene, ice, iron meteorite analogue, comet).
Diameter or radius of the projectile or impactor particle.
Material of the target or collector hit by the projectile (e.g. aluminium foil, gas target).

rules: The shock or peak temperature is not the reaction temperature: keep it in these columns (as printed; the app converts).
